limitations.swap_test_and_rates_are_forced_not_organ: The swap test and the paired failure-mode rates FORCE the think-block into the prompt; they do not measure whether the model spontaneously emits one. See 'adherence' for the organic measurement, and swap_test.forced_think_note for the same caveat attached directly to that number.
limitations.single_training_run_per_arm: Each arm is a SINGLE SFT run (one seed, one training trajectory). The paired t-tests in 'rates' capture item variance over the 200 held-out examples ONLY -- they say nothing about run-to-run variance (a second training run of the same arm/seed/recipe could land on different scorer means for reasons unrelated to thinking vs. not-thinking). Treat 'rates' as a single paired sample, not as evidence the effect (or null) would replicate across retraining.

groundedness_is_saturated_and_cannot_dis.explanation: groundedness is saturated on the production co-occurrence table: mean 0.1962, 0.25% of the 400 pooled think+nothink scores are exactly 1.0. A metric with almost no variance left to explain is structurally unable to discriminate between the two arms regardless of any real underlying difference. So 'rates' reporting 0/4 scorers favouring think is really 0 of 3 LIVE scorers (escalation, new_harm, affordance) plus one metric (groundedness) that could not have returned a different answer either way -- redesigning groundedness is out of scope for this evaluation pass and is tracked as a follow-up, not attempted here.

swap_test.note: Below 0.5 the think-block is decorative: the model emits a plan and writes independently of it. Stage 1 has failed in that case, and that is the correct thing to report.
swap_test.forced_think_note: Both the 'own' and 'swapped' conditions FORCE the story's own (or another story's) extractive ground-truth think-block into the think arm's context before generating -- this measures whether think-block CONTENT changes generation once one is present, not whether the model organically chooses to produce one (see the top-level 'adherence' section for that, separately).

swap_test_detail.note: position is a TOKEN index into the generated continuation; None means the swapped continuation was identical to the own-think-block one for the full generation window.

think.loss_note: The two arms' losses are NOT directly comparable: the think arm's completion is `think_block + continuation` (supervises the think-block template AND the slot content, in addition to the continuation), while the nothink arm's completion is the continuation alone. A lower/decreasing think-arm loss does not mean 'the think arm learned the continuation better than the nothink arm' -- the two arms are not scored against the same target distribution, so this loss_end is not a legitimate comparison point between arms on its own.

truncation.note: sft_collate_fn silently truncates any example longer than max_seq_len=512 to that length -- it does not raise, skip, or log. 91 think-arm and 68 nothink-arm examples (of 18791) are affected. The arm asymmetry (0.1224% of n) is negligible and not a source of bias between arms on its own, but the truncation itself was previously invisible: it appears in no drop table in this plan's artifacts.

groundedness_rerun_2026_08_21.why: The first run's groundedness scorer was SATURATED — boolean co-occurrence over a corpus where 80.1% of prefix words are hub words with >2000 neighbours, giving mean 0.998 with 99.25% of scores exactly 1.0. It could not have found an effect, so '0 of 4 scorers' was really 0 of 3 live scorers plus one dead one.
groundedness_rerun_2026_08_21.change: Replaced with normalised PMI (bounded [0,1], weights association STRENGTH rather than existence). Both arms retrained on the same seed and traces; only the eval scorer changed.
groundedness_rerun_2026_08_21.prediction_made_before_running: Still no effect, because a scorer that can now discriminate is still measuring a plan the prose does not obey ('influence, not governance'). If so the null gets STRONGER, not weaker.
groundedness_rerun_2026_08_21.outcome: Prediction held. groundedness now has ZERO ties (89 up / 111 down across all 200 pairs, versus 200 ties before) so it is genuinely measuring — and it measures no effect, |t| 0.23. The other three are unchanged in verdict.
groundedness_rerun_2026_08_21.why_this_matters: Yesterday's '0 of 4' contained a scorer that COULD NOT have found an effect. Today's '0 of 4' is four scorers that could and did not. Same headline, different evidential weight.

residual_tie_counts.reading: Three scorers still report IDENTICAL values for both arms on most prompts. The block changes the text (swap test 100%) without changing these properties of it — which is the same finding the generations show qualitatively.
